about: The Alleluia of the Vigil of the Nativity of the Lord, sung only when the Vigil falls on Sunday.

s01.narrative: It is said only when the Vigil falls on Sunday.

s02.translation: Alleluia, alleluia. Tomorrow the iniquity of the earth shall be blotted out, and the Savior of the world shall reign over us. Alleluia.
